set_default_hook_class: set the default hook class used by the SPDL pipeline for processing tasks
get_default_hook_class: get the currently configured default hook class from the SPDL pipeline configuration
set_default_queue_class: set the default queue class used by the SPDL pipeline for task scheduling
is_diagnostic_mode_enabled: check whether diagnostic mode is currently enabled in the SPDL pipeline runtime configuration
set_default_background_tasks: set the default number of background tasks for the SPDL pipeline worker pool
